scope: GenBank Eukaryota assemblies at chromosome or complete level

mitochondrial_association.definition: Assembly report contains associated organelleInfo with a description containing 'mitochond'.

plastid_association.denominator_definition: Viridiplantae assemblies in the tracked collection.
plastid_association.definition: Assembly report contains associated organelleInfo with a description containing 'chloroplast' or 'plastid'.

sex_chromosome_labels.definition: Explicit chromosome-name labels in the NCBI genome sequence report. This includes X/Y/Z/W-style and explicitly identified other sex-chromosome labels and measures assembly labelling, not the organism's inferred biological sex-determination system.

rules.XY labelled: Both X and Y labels detected, without Z/W.
rules.ZW labelled: Both Z and W labels detected, without X/Y.
rules.Other / partial label: At least one X/Y/Z/W-style or explicitly identified other sex-chromosome label detected, but not a clean XY or ZW pair.
rules.No sex-chromosome label: No explicit X/Y/Z/W-style or explicitly identified other sex-chromosome label detected.

sex_chromosome_expected_vs_observed.definition: Assembly-level comparison for chromosome/complete GenBank genomes. Expectations use an explicit Tree of Sex species karyotype first, then only fully concordant genus/family/order Tree-of-Sex evidence; Aves may inherit ZW because Tree of Sex explicitly describes birds as uniform in sex-determination system. Observed labels come from NCBI sequence reports.

rules.XY / complex XY: Expected when both X and Y labels are observed.
rules.XO: Expected when an X label is observed.
rules.ZW / complex ZW: Expected when both Z and W labels are observed.
rules.ZO / WO: Expected when the corresponding Z or W label is observed.

karyotype_audit.definition: Observed NCBI total chromosome count compared with Tree of Sex female/male 2N values. Because assemblies can represent a haploid chromosome complement, agreement is assessed against both reported 2N and N where 2N is even; the closer expectation is used.

assembly_quality.definition: Current NCBI assembly statistics for the tracked chromosome-scale/complete GenBank collection.

source.sequence_report: NCBI Datasets genome sequence report (chrName; assembled-molecule/chromosome records)
source.tree_of_sex: Tree of Sex karyotype snapshot dated 2022-10-09; original database described by The Tree of Sex Consortium (2014), Scientific Data 1:140015.
